responsibility: Defines the VAX backend’s custom RTL operand predicates and condition-code operator classes used by instruction recognition. These predicates classify symbolic and PIC-safe operands, reject illegal indexed/indirect/predecrement memory forms for block and DImode operations, recognize volatile and general memory operands, and partition branch comparisons by the narrow VAX CC modes (CC, CCN, CCNZ, CCZ) so that patterns in vax.md can select correct addressing and PSL-condition handling.
